functions.source:
DECLARE
    v_rep_id uuid;
BEGIN
    -- 1. Find the ultimate representative for this patient
    SELECT COALESCE(family_representative_id, p_patient_id) INTO v_rep_id
    FROM patients
    WHERE id = p_patient_id;

    -- 2. Return all members who either are the rep OR point to the rep
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.phone, p.avatar_url, 
        p.family_relationship, p.is_family_head, p.family_representative_id,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE patient_id = p.id AND status = 'completed') as appointments_count,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM billings WHERE patient_id = p.id AND status = 'paid') as total_billed,
        p.status
    FROM patients p
    WHERE p.id = v_rep_id 
       OR p.family_representative_id = v_rep_id
       -- Also catch cases where the rep might point to another rep (shallow tree support)
       OR p.family_representative_id IN (SELECT id FROM patients WHERE family_representative_id = v_rep_id)
    ORDER BY p.is_family_head DESC, p.first_name ASC;
END;
